Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results recorded in the paper. The main claims about FV performance (90.8% shuffled-label, 57.5% zero-shot for GPT-J), natural text portability (55-68% for Antonym), vocabulary reconstruction (58.1% vs 83.2% for Country-Capital), and vector algebra composition results (Last-Country-Capital v*BD=0.60 vs ICL=0.32) all match between conclusions and tabulated results.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: The plan specifies 4 methodology steps and 6 experiments. Step 4 (Test vector algebra composition) is missing from the implementation. While the plan describes experiments combining FVs algebraically (v*BD = vAD + vBC - vAC) to create composed vectors for list-oriented tasks, no implementation script exists to perform this experiment. The other 5 experiments (portability, vocabulary reconstruction, causal mediation, diverse tasks, natural text) are all implemented in the codebase.
